name: Posledniye Slova
source:
"I have heard a lot about this place...
I've been told a lot about it...
How interesting and fun it is for the kids who come here year after year...
How much I will gain for myself here...
Socializing, acquaintances...
And even love.
The hours, days, and weeks spent here will be remembered for the rest of my life...
I'm describing an amazing place, aren't I?
I knew where I was going...
After all, I had already been here more than once, but...
Why?
Why did I return here again?
I want to find out if the camp has remained the same as it was back then.
But was that the main reason?
Or do I truly believe that the camp hasn't changed over the past few years?
But in any case...
I have nothing to lose."

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1780790686]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“我听说过很多关于这个地方的事……
我已经被告知很多关于它的事了…
对于年复一年来到这里的孩子们来说，这是多么有趣和好玩啊……
在这里我能为自己收获多少……
社交、认识…
甚至爱情。
在这里度过的几个小时、几天和几周将被我的余生铭记……
我正在描述一个很棒的地方，不是吗？
我知道我要去哪里…
毕竟我已经来过这里不止一次了，但是……
为什么？
我怎么又回到这里了？
我想知道这个营地是否还和以前一样。
但这是主要原因吗？
或者我真的相信过去几年营地没有改变吗？
但无论如何…
我没有什么可失去的。”

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1780790686]Steam[/url]]
